answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 11504 Country: India Title: Assalaam alaikkum I WANT TO KNOW IS IT COMPULSARY TO HAVE A BATH FOR WOMEN AFTER having a sex USING THE CONDOME? Question: Assalaam alaikkum I WANT TO KNOW IS IT COMPULSARY TO HAVE A BATH FOR WOMEN AFTER having a sex USING THE CONDOME? Answer ID: 11504 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 493/364=L/1430) Using condom without any valid reason is makrooh. However, if anyone had sex using condom then both will have to take bath: أولج حشفتہ أو قدرھا ملفوفۃ بخرقۃ إن وجد لذۃ الجماع وجب الغسل وإلا لا علی الأصح، والأحوط الوجوب أي وجوب الغسل في الوجھین (الدر المختار مع الشامی 1:303 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
